affordances.name: Horse Model
affordances.semantic: The horse mesh with soft-body physics applied, divided into 6 grooming zones

affordances.name: Kira Character
affordances.semantic: Kira model standing to the left of the horse, plays reaction animations

affordances.name: Brush Tool Button
affordances.semantic: UI button to select the brush tool for grooming

affordances.name: Pressure Slider
affordances.semantic: Slider control to adjust brush pressure from 0.0 to 1.0

affordances.name: Zone Progress Panel
affordances.semantic: UI panel displaying completion percentages for all 6 grooming zones

affordances.name: Horse Surface Interaction
affordances.semantic: Click and drag interaction on horse mesh to apply grooming strokes

states.name: Initial Load
states.description: Scene loaded with horse and Kira models visible, no tool selected, all zones at 0% progress

states.name: Brush Tool Selected
states.description: User has selected the brush tool and adjusted pressure, ready to groom

states.name: First Zone Grooming
states.description: User is actively grooming zones, at least one zone has progress > 0%, soft-body deformations visible
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.totalGroomingStrokes > 0 && (window.__3D_STATE__.headZoneProgress > 0 || window.__3D_STATE__.neckZoneProgress > 0 || window.__3D_STATE__.backZoneProgress > 0 || window.__3D_STATE__.leftFlankZoneProgress > 0 || window.__3D_STATE__.rightFlankZoneProgress > 0 || window.__3D_STATE__.hindquartersZoneProgress > 0) && window.__3D_STATE__.groomedZoneCount === 0

states.name: Multiple Zones Progressed
states.description: User has groomed multiple zones, at least 3 zones have progress > 30%, Kira has reacted

states.name: First Zone Complete
states.description: At least one grooming zone has reached 100% completion

states.name: All Zones Complete
states.description: All 6 grooming zones have reached 100% completion, grooming routine finished
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.groomedZoneCount >= 6 && window.__3D_STATE__.headZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.neckZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.leftFlankZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.rightFlankZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.backZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.hindquartersZoneProgress === 100

states.name: Stable Completion
states.description: Task completed and stable for extended period, all zones remain at 100%
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.groomedZoneCount >= 6 && window.__3D_STATE__.headZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.neckZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.leftFlankZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.rightFlankZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.backZoneProgress === 100 && window.__3D_STATE__.hindquartersZoneProgress === 100

action.code: document.querySelector('[data-tool="brush"]')?.click(); const slider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if(slider) { slider.value = 0.7; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Brush tool is selected and active
Brush pressure is set to a non-zero value

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); if(canvas) { for(let i=0; i<8; i++) { const x = canvas.width * (0.4 + Math.random()*0.2); const y = canvas.height * (0.3 + Math.random()*0.3); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: x+20, clientY: y+10, bubbles: true})); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: x+20, clientY: y+10, bubbles: true})); }, 100 + i*150); } }

postconditions: User has applied multiple grooming strokes to the horse
At least one zone shows progress greater than 0%

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); if(canvas) { const zones = [{x:0.5,y:0.25},{x:0.45,y:0.4},{x:0.55,y:0.4},{x:0.5,y:0.5}]; zones.forEach((zone, idx) => { for(let i=0; i<12; i++) { setTimeout(() => { const x = canvas.width * (zone.x + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.1); const y = canvas.height * (zone.y + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.1); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: x+15, clientY: y+15, bubbles: true})); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: x+15, clientY: y+15, bubbles: true})); }, 80); }, idx*800 + i*120); } }); }

postconditions: Multiple zones have been groomed with significant progress
At least 3 zones show progress above 30%
Kira has played at least one reaction animation

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); if(canvas) { for(let round=0; round<3; round++) { setTimeout(() => { for(let i=0; i<20; i++) { setTimeout(() => { const x = canvas.width * (0.45 + Math.random()*0.1); const y = canvas.height * (0.25 + Math.random()*0.1); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: x+10, clientY: y+10, bubbles: true})); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: x+10, clientY: y+10, bubbles: true})); }, 60); }, i*100); } }, round*2500); } }

postconditions: At least one grooming zone has reached 100% completion
Groomed zone count is at least 1

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); if(canvas) { const allZones = [{x:0.5,y:0.25},{x:0.5,y:0.35},{x:0.4,y:0.45},{x:0.6,y:0.45},{x:0.5,y:0.5},{x:0.5,y:0.6}]; allZones.forEach((zone, zIdx) => { for(let i=0; i<25; i++) { setTimeout(() => { const x = canvas.width * (zone.x + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08); const y = canvas.height * (zone.y + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.08); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: x+12, clientY: y+8, bubbles: true})); canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: x+12, clientY: y+8, bubbles: true})); }, 70); }, zIdx*2000 + i*90); } }); }

postconditions: All 6 grooming zones have reached 100% completion
All zones remain at 100% completion after 60 seconds
